title: An $O_K$-basis for the image of a Lubin-Tate logarithm on $π$-regular extensions of $K$
summary: Let $K$ be a finite $p$-adic field with uniformiser $π$. In this paper we study the image of the logarithm attached to a Lubin-Tate series $[π](X)$ on the maximal ideal of so-called $π$-regular extensions of $K$; for such an extension $L|K$ we compute a basis for the additive group $\log_{[π]}(\mathcal{F}(\mathfrak{m}_L))$ as an $O_K$-module, where $\mathcal{F}(\mathfrak{m}_L)$ denotes the maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}_L$ equipped with the $O_K$-module structure coming from the formal group associated to $[π](X)$, and determine the minimal valuation of the elements in…
